The company shows solid profitability with revenue of over $4.07B, an operating margin of 14% ($552M), and positive net income of $384M. However, its balance sheet is highly leveraged with a high liabilities-to-equity ratio (liabilities of $4.39B against equity of $941M, or ~82% leverage) and weak short-term liquidity, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.91 ($1,460M current assets vs $1,598M current liabilities). This combination of stable profitability but highly leveraged capital structure and tight liquidity is characteristic of a mid-to-lower investment-grade or strong speculative-grade issuer.

DECISION: BBB-
